Leaning over the sturdy wooden railing are two figures in windbreakers, peering down at two plump brown sea lions perched on timber beams below. On the left, two colorful cruiser bikes rest against the rail. The sun casts sharp, warm shadows across the splintered gray planks. Premium collectible product shot with soft highlights and no harsh reflections. The whole world is one compact object, centered, filling about two thirds of the frame with empty space on every side, seen from a three-quarter angle slightly above. Nothing extends beyond its edges: no horizon, sky or distant scenery behind it. Plain seamless soft neutral background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
